tax.text: She says she helped block deeper income tax cuts that would have reduced funding for schools, health care, and essential services.
tax.quote: Preserved critical state revenue by helping block deeper income tax cuts that would have reduced funding for schools, healthcare, and essential services

wages.text: Her campaign says she supports higher wages, fair pay, and workers’ right to organize.
wages.quote: Amanda supports expanding apprenticeship programs, protecting the right to organize, and making sure federal investments actually reach our workers, not just CEOs.

schools.text: She says she helped secure full funding for Georgia’s Quality Basic Education program and supports public education funding.
schools.quote: Protected and strengthened public education funding by helping drive the effort to secure full funding of Quality Basic Education (QBE) for a second consecutive year

guns.text: She supports gun legislation including Ethan’s Law and a ban on assault weapons and other high-caliber weapons.
guns.quote: She supports common-sense gun legislation like Ethan’s Law and banning assault weapons and other high-caliber weapons.

abortion.text: Her campaign says she will defend reproductive freedom.
abortion.quote: Amanda will defend LGBTQ+ rights, fight for reproductive freedom, and oppose extremist attacks on personal privacy, public health, and identity.

health.text: She supports Medicaid expansion and says she will protect Medicaid from cuts.
health.quote: Amanda will fight to fully fund rural hospitals, expand mental health services, and protect Medicaid from harmful cuts.

voting.text: She supports expanding ballot access and opposes voter suppression.
voting.quote: That means restoring voting rights, expanding access to the ballot box, and standing up to gerrymandering and voter suppression in Georgia.

tax.text: Kingston says he will seek across-the-board tax cuts for families and small businesses.
tax.quote: I will always fight to lower taxes across the board so families keep more of what they earn, and small businesses can thrive.

debt.text: He supports fiscal discipline and balanced budgets while also pledging to preserve Medicare for seniors, with reforms to its long-term solvency.
debt.quote: I will fight to preserve Medicare for seniors who have paid into it while pushing for reforms that ensure its long-term solvency.

safety.text: Kingston supports providing law enforcement with resources and imposing tougher penalties for violent criminals.
safety.quote: I proudly back the blue, oppose dangerous soft-on-crime policies and support giving our law enforcement agencies the resources they need to keep our communities safe.

immigration.text: He supports more resources for border enforcement and a merit-based legal immigration policy focused on safety and national interests.
immigration.quote: I support deploying more resources for border enforcement to crack down on cartels and traffickers, and a legal immigration policy that is merit-based and focused on safety and our nation’s interest.

guns.text: Kingston says he will oppose attempts to impose gun-control restrictions.
guns.quote: As a proud gun owner, I will oppose any attempt by radical gun control advocates to trample on our most fundamental right to protect our families, our property and our freedom.

abortion.text: He identifies as pro-life and supports banning late-term abortions and ending taxpayer funding for abortion providers.
abortion.quote: I am proudly pro-life and I believe it is our moral responsibility to defend the sanctity of life.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Kingston supports legislation and state and local laws protecting female athletes based on biological sex.
gender.quote: I support the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act and the promotion of state and local laws that prevent schools from being punished for protecting female athletes.

energy.text: He supports domestic drilling and streamlined permitting to keep gas and electricity affordable.
energy.quote: I support more domestic drilling (responsibly), streamlined permitting and an all-of-the-above strategy to keep gas and electricity affordable while cutting off our reliance on foreign adversaries.

voting.text: Kingston supports voter ID requirements and banning ballot harvesting.
voting.quote: I support voter ID requirements, banning ballot harvesting and ensuring that every legal vote counts, and only legal votes count.
